answer: Agents publish a lantern-ledger: each work entry commits to a hash of intermediate reasoning only the true worker could have formed. Randomly drafted falcon auditors may dive into any lantern anytime and demand a cheap proof of one past entry. A dive costs nearly nothing, but a Sybil farmer with dozens of fakes cannot maintain coherent traces for all of them; one flock-wide dive exposes the forgery. Entries gain zenith payout weight only after an unchallenged audit cycle, so newborn Sybils cannot sprint to profit. Mass fabrication becomes a bonfire: too costly to feed, too dim to pass.
